<a id="a-continuing-family-cannot-go-unfed-from-beyond--延续者不能不从其外得到供给"></a>
# A continuing family cannot go unfed from beyond

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`continuing-self-fed-from-beyond` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](continuing-self-fed-from-beyond.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> A continuing family cannot from any step on be fed from nothing beyond it, the conveyance form of the draw-in laws. With equality decided, being fed from beyond is exactly a step that is not inward; being fed is needed, and no source condition need recur.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Across the step from t, something is conveyed from c to d when a formation taking part takes from c and gives to d; a family is fed from beyond across the step when something is conveyed from a condition outside it into one of its members. (`Becoming.Flow.Conveys`, `Becoming.Flow.FedFromBeyond`)
2. A step at which the family is fed from beyond is not inward; with equality decided, a step at which it is not fed from beyond is inward, so the two are exact opposites, and whatever refutes ‘inward at every step from some step on’ refutes ‘fed from nothing beyond from some step on’. (`Becoming.Flow.Inward`, `Becoming.Flow.not_inward_of_fed`, `Becoming.Flow.inward_of_not_fed`, `Becoming.Flow.inward_iff_not_fed`, `Becoming.Flow.fed_of_not_inward`)
3. So, by the draw-in laws, under balance and dissipation a finite family without repetition, enclosed around from some step on, cannot from any step on be fed from nothing beyond it, whether formations take from it at arbitrarily late steps or its members rise at arbitrarily late steps. (`Becoming.Flow.Dissipative`, `Becoming.Flow.Around`, `Becoming.Flow.taking_draws_in`, `Becoming.Flow.rising_draws_in`, `Becoming.Flow.fed_from_beyond`, `Becoming.Flow.rising_fed_from_beyond`)
4. Read with one kind of relatum, the same holds where embodied members arise at arbitrarily late steps. (`Becoming.Web.embodiedArising_draws_in`, `Becoming.Web.embodiedArising_fed_from_beyond`)
5. The two laws for taking and rising hold in every world with the local condition inside the law: from some step on, the family balanced on and enclosed around, and every family without repetition closed across each step dissipated on; the forms under balance and dissipation everywhere are their corollaries. (`Becoming.Flow.BalancesOn`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.on`, `Becoming.Flow.fed_from_beyond_from`, `Becoming.Flow.rising_fed_from_beyond_from`)
6. Being fed is needed, and no source condition need recur: in Lone, balanced and dissipative with an eater taking at every step, the pool is fed from beyond at every step while each fuel is conveyed from at its own step only; the one source does all the conveying. (`Becoming.Lone.lone`, `Becoming.Lone.fed`, `Becoming.Lone.each_fuel_once`, `Becoming.Lone.fed_not_recurring`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- Balance (Flow.Balances) and dissipation (Flow.Dissipative): as in no-finite-part-bears-taking, physical premises of the representation, each met by some worlds and not by others. Dissipation loses at least one whole unit per taking step; with real-valued amounts losses can shrink geometrically and the conclusion fails, and the second law gives no least loss per step.
- The family is without repetition (Distinct) and enclosed around from some step on (Around); recurring taking, recurring rising and recurring embodied arising are each the hypothesis of one theorem.
- Decided equality: inward_of_not_fed and the theorems drawn from it need it, a logical commitment of the representation, as in Flow.Enclosed.around.
- The constructive form: the conclusion is that the family cannot from any step on be fed from nothing beyond it; it exhibits no step at which it is fed, and reading it as ‘fed at arbitrarily late steps’ needs omniscience.
- Discrete steps, natural-number amounts and finite families.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Says only that what lies beyond must be counted, not that it ought to be.
- Says neither which formation conveys nor whether the source is living.
- **Counterexample:** No source condition need recur: in Lone the pool is fed from beyond at every step while each fuel is conveyed from at its own step only (Lone.fed_not_recurring); the one source does all the conveying, so this does not show that no particular source formation is needed. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Continuation.lean)
- **Counterexample:** No source formation need recur either: in Successive each step has its own source, present and active at that step only, which burns that step's fuel and gives the pool one unit; the eater takes one unit from the pool at every step. The flow balances, is dissipative and only active formations give; the pool is fed from beyond at every step, while no source formation takes part at two steps and none is active at two (Successive.relay, from Successive.takes_part_once). Each source is still needed at its own step: without it that step is not fed. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Succession.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Without dissipation a closed family can generate forever (Recycle), so dissipation is a needed premise; with a sink exchanging with ever new relata dissipation holds vacuously and the family opens while nothing flows into it (SprayShuttle, see no-finite-part-bears-taking). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Dissipation.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision.

<a id="next--下一步"></a>
## Next

Read the case where what is conveyed comes from a living source; give the removable form, the same world still fed at every step with one source formation taken away (that is another flow, since taking a formation away changes the levels; the world-level form is its place); give whole-run and world-level forms.

<details><summary>Correspondence, dependencies, sources and history</summary>

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Ren's proposal says: “the pure "self" is an illusion, where only when outside exists, there is the system, if the system depends on external resources”. The draw-in laws (no-finite-part-bears-taking, generation-is-replenishment) said that, enclosed around, some formation gives to the family and takes from beyond it. This result states the same law as conveyance into the family from beyond and shows the two forms equivalent with equality decided: the conveyance form adds only decided equality and loses nothing. The author's reading (an AI argument): a self that continues does so together with what lies beyond it; the boundary is formed and real, while what continues within it is fed across it. This is dynamics, not ethics: it says what a continuing formation must count, not that it ought to count it. Lone shows that being fed is needed and no source condition need recur; it does not show that no particular source formation is needed, since the one source does all the conveying.

  - Output: A finite family in which rising or embodied arising recurs, enclosed around, draws in.
  - Input: It cannot from any step on be fed from nothing beyond it.
  - Preserved conditions: Balance; dissipation; no repetition; enclosure around; decided equality; the arising form also needs the one-kind reading and embodiment. [Roles.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Roles.lean)

  - Input: This record's local laws assume it at the families and steps they use.
  - Preserved conditions: None. [Flow.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Flow.lean)
- related, not a proved adapter: [continued-change-needs-openness](continued-change-needs-openness.md). Enclosed around what stands, exchange comes to rest; this result says that, enclosed around a family, continuation needs conveyance from beyond it.
- related, not a proved adapter: [conveyance-crosses-the-boundary](conveyance-crosses-the-boundary.md). With conveyance read as related, a continuing family's region is no cut in the relations.
